subject: Re: Evidence request — onboarding, background checks & training logs
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@greenlighthealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: security@greenlighthealth.com
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: hiring, background checks and training logs

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you’re well. Our SOC 2 assessor asked us to collect a small set of HR control artifacts to validate onboarding/offboarding and personnel security controls. Can you please provide the following by Tue, Aug 31: 

- Redacted background check log (sample of ~10 hires across the last 12–18 months) indicating check performed, vendor name, and verification date. PII should be redacted.
- Training completion export for Security Awareness & Data Handling (last 12 months) with timestamps and course IDs.
- Current onboarding checklist/playbook and offboarding/deprovisioning runbook.
- Attestation that background check vendor contracts include data handling clauses (if available).

If you prefer, a shared Drive folder with files and a short attestation PDF is fine. Let me know if you need clarification on scope or redaction.

Thanks,
Jane Doe
Security Program Manager
Greenlight Health

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@greenlighthealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: hiring, background checks and training logs

Hi Jane — thanks for the request and the timeline.

High level plan: Marcus (HR ops) will pull the redacted background-check samples and the training export; Laura will confirm the contractual language for vendor clauses and prepare an attestation template. We’ll drop files into a shared Drive folder and post a link here by EOD Mon, Aug 22.

Quick clarifying questions so we minimize rework:
- Do you need the sample to include contractors or only full-time employees?
- For the training export, is including internal user IDs okay if we also provide a mapping CSV with redacted emails (we’ll remove full emails)?

Attaching our current onboarding playbook (onboarding_playbook.pdf) so you can confirm format — it includes the HR verification and access provisioning steps.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: onboarding_playbook.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@greenlighthealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Aug 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: hiring, background checks and training logs

Jane — I pulled the exports and placed redacted samples in the Drive folder. Summary below and quick notes on redaction/retention: 

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_drive_link
Files uploaded (stubs):
- background_check_log_redacted_2026-2027.csv — columns: hire_id (internal id), check_vendor, check_date, result_status. All candidate names and PII removed.
- training_completion_export_2026-07_2027-07.csv — columns: user_id (internal), course_id, completion_timestamp, status. We removed email addresses and replaced them with internal IDs.
- offboarding_runbook_v2.pdf — lists steps for deprovisioning cloud accounts, disabling SSO, ticketing and hardware return.

Retention & scope notes: our policy retains background check artifacts for 7 years; for SOC 2 purposes we typically provide 12–18 months of samples. The files in the folder are redacted CSV exports; if you need a signed attestation we can produce that once Laura confirms language.

Sample row (background_check_log_redacted_2026-2027.csv):
hire_id,check_vendor,check_date,result_status
H-001234,ClearVerify,2026-10-12,Passed

Let me know if you need additional columns (vendor reference number, case ID) — we can add them after a quick PII review.

Attachments (referenced as stubs): background_check_log_redacted_2026-2027.csv, training_completion_export_2026-07_2027-07.csv, offboarding_runbook_v2.pdf

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
HR Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@greenlighthealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: hiring, background checks and training logs

Thanks Marcus — that folder and the sample look good. A couple quick follow-ups:

- Contractors: please include a mixed sample (6 FTEs + 4 contractors) so our assessor sees both flows.
- Retention confirmation: can Laura provide a one-paragraph attestation we can include in the SOC 2 package that states the retention policy and that PII is redacted in shared artifacts? We’ll need a signed copy (DocuSign is fine).

I’ve sent a DocuSign attestation request (link below) — feel free to route it to the appropriate signer. Once we have the attestation and the mixed sample, we’ll mark this item closed on our end.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/attestation/XYZ-123-attest

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Jane
Security Program Manager
Greenlight Health
